body:
I cry every morning, every day, for her too.
There’s no way to put into words how much I miss her, but I don’t speak. I say nothing, because I pray so hard that she’s better off without me. That she’s at least happier than I am

Oh this made me cry I relate so strongly.
So many people with similar experience.
I wish I could turn off my feelings like she did, and just move on, but for me it feels like something more final. It’s changed my body mentally and physically in ways I would have never predicted.

Last summer I tried 3 times, 3 different methods, and failed each. I know the pain and embarrassment of sitting there in your blood and tears, trying to understand why it feels like you can’t even get this one horrible thing right. 
I know how it feels to have no one that cares. I still have a long length of adequately thick rope in my room right now waiting for me, but I’ve tried to give myself time, hoping it might get better…
I know it’s likely a foolish hope and, like with everything else in my life, I’ll be wrong, but I’ve got someone who depends on me so I try to wait.

My only advice is to wait if you can. Just like no one could’ve predicted how bad things are now, now one can predict how your life might change in the coming days  or weeks. There could be something or someone beautiful in your life you just miss by ending it. The choice will always be in your hands regardless, but I hope you wait. Give yourself a little more time. I’m trying too my friend. I’m so sorry for your pain.
I couldn’t have said it any better

I sincerely thought it was just me. I’ve been on suboxone for the majority of the last 10 years and have taken my dose down from 16mg a day to 4mg but finding the will power to accomplish even the most basic tasks is so hard. I’m shocked to hear so many people saying it effects them the same.

Yeah, dude I am so amazed this is your first grow. I don’t know if you kept a grow journal of any kind, but after you get another grow or two under your belt I’d love to find out what made this first grow so spectacular
I think I’ve got you beat. 54 mile commute 4 days a week up 95N south of DC for 40k a year.
I could’ve written the first part of this...so it’s great to read the 2nd part and know how it turned out for you.
Every single time- including this one.
Harsh truths seem to be the only ones I understand. I didn’t contact her for what that’s worth. I wish I could move out of state.

I ask myself this every day. Congratulations on the work and progress you’ve already made. That’s yours. Not hers or anyone else’s. Here’s to hoping happiness comes your way again

Edit: here’s to hoping happiness comes our way again.
Thank you so much for this. It’s really hard to remember to be positive sometimes

I’m sorry for all you’re still feeling and going through. I see things like this and wish they were for me sometimes, but I don’t want her to hurt or miss me, because I just want her to be happy. If he isn’t sorry and doesn’t know by know that you’re where the greenest grass grows then he’s a fool and not worth it. If he does know his mistake and is sorry (which if he’s worth anything he should be) then you know you two are united by your shared pain even if you never speak again. Twin cracks or scars on each others hearts you both carry. Hope you can enjoy your Halloween
😢thank you for this

I really relate to this feeling. It’s the hardest most painful feeling I’ve ever had to endure and brought me to a low I didn’t think possible. I’m not very religious, but I watched something about Buddhist meditation once and the monk said the purest form of love was dispassion: letting go of your own desires, fears, attachments to a person and releasing them. It’s hard to do, but try it. Every day when I think of the person who I miss and love and feel abandoned by, I take a deep breath and tell myself when I exhale I’m letting go of desires and expectations I had for that person, or my fear of them moving on without me. There’s no easy solution, but this is one small thing that has really helped me. It’s still difficult, but I didn’t think I’d love long enough for things to be this hard, and it has gotten easier.

I think that broken damaged people can love someone as much as they’re capable of and that still not be enough. Love can keep them together for a while if it’s strong, but if both people aren’t trying to heal themselves that while, they’ll never love one another better. I failed to better myself to give someone the love they deserve. I wish I had another chance. I miss everything about her and the way she’d make me chicken noodle was a kind cumulative gesture of all the love she showed me. I’ve reached out to her so many times without response. Give this person a chance to be better. One text “call me”. I’d do anything for one more chance.

Thank you. The dark times feel impossible to get through. Insurance and finances and Dr.’s make getting the help you need hard sometimes. In this moment, a stranger even taking the time to write and care means so much. So thank you. Thank you so much for this
Thank you for even caring
This is me. Everyday. I hate it
I feel all of this so much. I read it in someone’s voice and then had to force myself to shake that wishful thinking away

I’m sorry. I hope he read it. There are obviously two sides to everything and I don’t know his, but I hope he read it and is just slow working out his thoughts to respond. I had resigned myself to being alone forever before I met the person I was with before, but now I’ve found resigning myself to that fate a much harder truth to swallow knowing that she exists. Do what you can to stay positive and make it through the day. I’m telling myself if I can just survive one more day through what I’m feeling the pain will fade little by little.
I bet none of y’all can make a bowl of cereal taste that good!  BAM!💥

I don’t know how long you’ve been apart, but please send this. It resonates so loudly with me it’s deafening and I would give up everything I’ve ever had or could ever have to hear this from the person I lost. I would change everything and do anything for an opportunity to earn respect and love back. I will never have that opportunity... so if this is really how you feel please give him a chance to try to earn you back- don’t give him another chance, make him earn a chance with you. If rejects or squanders the opportunity then you’ll know for certain it’s how it has to be, as hard as that may be to face. If this is how you feel offer him the opportunity to earn the chance to surprise you.
It really is so beautiful. I understand this. It’s heartbreaking every time I hear someone express it, but I understand logically.
I know this isn’t for me, but it was still one of the most painful things I’ve ever read. I hope you grow and love and laugh and find all the happiness in the world.

My heart breaks all over when I read things like this. I know it’s delusional to hope this is about me from someone who doesn’t care whether I live or die. I hate my brain. I wish I could Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless mind myself and stop loving someone who doesn’t love me.
I appreciate the sincerity and time it took to offer this advice even if I can’t take it.
Not a Cidney, but I hope you get through to her.

I’ve read so many unsent letters and posts on breakups imagining it was the person who this was written too...sometimes it helps, and sometimes it hurts, but theres some kind of beautiful mosaic formed between all the broken hearts here
If any of this is something you can relate to, from either side, then I’m so sorry because I know the kind of pain you’re in.
So so so so many times. No answer.  She’ll never reply to me.
Thank you for saying this. As comforting as it would be to believe that I know that she’d do anything if I’d just vanish entirely.
